definitions.gloss: arrival and departure, coming and going
definitions.explanation: The combined concept of departing from and arriving at a location, typically used for transportation schedules and facilities.

examples.japanese: {発着|はっちゃく}⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Check the arrival and departure times.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発着|はっちゃく}⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}ち{合|あ}わせた→待ち合わせる：12328_machiawaseru⟧。
examples.english: We met at the airport's arrivals and departures lobby.
500 trains arrive and depart from this station daily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発着|はっちゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れ：01908_okure⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Flights are experiencing delays in arrivals and departures due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成田|なりた}→成田：noentry⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際線|こくさいせん}→国際線：27502_kokusaisen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発着|はっちゃく}⟦{便数|びんすう}→便数：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Narita Airport has the most international flight arrivals and departures in Japan.

notes:
FORMATION: {発|はつ} (departure) + {着|ちゃく} (arrival). A compound of opposites that together mean "comings and goings".

USAGE:
・{発着|はっちゃく}する is intransitive. The vehicle is the subject and takes ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧; the place takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or is left to the topic, as in example 3.
・Most often the word is a noun modifier attached directly to another noun — {発着|はっちゃく}⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧, {発着|はっちゃく}⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧ — with no ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ in between.
・Because it covers both directions at once, it belongs to schedules, signboards, and announcements rather than to talk about a single trip. To say that one train left or one plane landed, use ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧ or ⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧.
・Applies to ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧, ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧, ⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧, ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧ and ships — anything that runs to a timetable.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{発着|はっちゃく}⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧ (arrival/departure times)
・{発着|はっちゃく}⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧ (arrival/departure guide)
・{発着|はっちゃく}⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧ (arrivals/departures lobby)
・{発着|はっちゃく}⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧ (arriving/departing flights)

RELATED TERMS:
・⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧ (departure only)
・⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧ (arrival only)
・⟦{発車|はっしゃ}→発車：03694_hassha⟧ (a vehicle pulling out, especially a train)
